title: nyssa sylvatica var. caroliniana
intro: Nyssa sylvatica var. caroliniana, commonly known as Carolina Black Gum or Black Tupelo, is a deciduous tree native to the southeastern United States. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help to reduce stress and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Nyssa sylvatica var. caroliniana include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, making it useful for treating various conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
